title: SajaoContract
description: Generated from schemas/v1. Do not edit.

AddEdit.title: AddEdit
AddEdit.description: Add a catalog product at a pose.

by.description: Who made the edit. Never a model.

Area.description: One space of a capture: its floor, what is in it and a photo that shows it.

floor_polygon.description: In the space frame, seen from above.

object_ids.description: Objects and built-ins whose footprint centre is in this area.

keyframe_ids.description: Keyframes taken standing in this area.

photo_keyframe_id.description: The keyframe that shows the most of this area's floor, for the app to show when asking which area to redesign.

ArPoint.description: A point in the AR session's world frame, in metres, y up.

ArPose.description: Camera pose from AR tracking: position and a unit quaternion (x, y, z, w).

Brief.title: Brief
Brief.description: Per-room choices on top of the taste profile. With the space profile and the catalog, the only input the design engine reads.

flexibility.description: strict is never relaxed; stretch_10 allows up to 10% over.

keep_item_ids.description: Existing items in the space profile to keep.

BuiltIn.description: Something built into the room (a fitted wardrobe, a fireplace, a radiator, a kitchen counter). Part of the shell: it stays when the room is redesigned.

CameraPose.description: Camera position and orientation in the space frame. Rotation is a unit quaternion (x, y, z, w).

Capture.title: Capture
Capture.description: Input stage: the photos or video of any space, at any extent (a whole room, a corner, a balcony), plus optional tape values. The space type is detected later, not picked here.

user_id.description: Owner. Guest sessions have a user id too.

captured_at_ms.description: Milliseconds from the start of the scan.

has_ar_pose.description: True when an ARKit or ARCore pose is attached. Never required.

CapturePackage.description: Everything the scan recorded for building the twin, uploaded as one package. Works without AR: then there is video and keyframes only, with no poses. AR poses and points are in the AR session's world frame: metres, gravity aligned, y up; the twin converts them to the space frame.

depth.description: Depth images are in the package.

video_start_ms.description: When the scan video's first frame was taken, in milliseconds from the start of the capture, so the video can be lined up with the keyframes and the sensor log.

scene_mesh.description: LiDAR scene mesh with surface classes, when the phone has LiDAR.

depth.description: Depth images aligned to keyframes, when the phone provides them.

detections.description: Live detector results during the scan.

sensor_log.description: Motion, pose and light readings over time, as JSON lines.

review_windows.description: Times when the review was open over the scan, in milliseconds from the start of the capture. The phone was lowered then: frames of the video inside a window are not part of the scan and are dropped on the server.

fits_box.description: The product's catalog size fits this object's box, with the error band as margin.

passed.description: True only when every hard rule, the budget and the stock check pass.

CompassReading.description: Compass headings averaged across the capture, used for Vastu direction.

Design.title: Design
Design.description: One proposed transformation. The render, the plan and the shopping list are views of this object and must never disagree with it.

slot.description: Which of the three intents this design fills.

total_cost.description: Sum of the item prices, computed by code from the same items the render shows.

relaxations.description: Every relaxation used, in the order applied. Shown on the design.

explanations.description: Why this works, generated from the solver's own scores.

twin.description: The twin this design builds on and its edits. The render, plan, 3D view and shopping list read the same twin plus edits.

product.description: Snapshot of the product at design time.

position.description: Center of the item's footprint in the space frame.

placed_by.description: Positions come from the solver or a user drag, never from a generative model.

DetectionSource.description: detected: worked out from the scan. user: changed or confirmed by the user.

Dimension.description: A length that is honest about where it came from. Every dimension carries a value, a source and an error band.

error_band_m.description: Half-width of the error band in metres: the true value is expected within value_m plus or minus error_band_m. The solver adds it as margin.

DimensionSource.description: measured: tape or verified retailer data. estimated: from geometry models or unverified listings. user_confirmed: accepted by the user without a tape value.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: Action stage: one entry in the event log (saves, swaps, buy taps, shares).

name.description: Event name from the tracking plan.

position.description: Position of the tapped item in its list, for click attribution.

properties.description: Event-specific properties from the tracking plan.

action.description: The user's choice for this item.

Fixture.description: A wall fixture that must stay accessible.

Footprint.description: Where a thing stands on the floor plan: its box seen from above, in the space frame. From the fused geometry, never from a model.

width.description: The longer side, with its error band: each edge may be off by up to that band.

depth.description: The shorter side, with its error band.

on_floor.description: Whether it takes up floor: false for things on a wall or hanging from the ceiling, whose box does not reach down to the floor.

FreeFloor.description: Floor a redesign can use: the floor polygon minus the footprints of everything kept that stands on the floor (objects marked keep, and built-ins).

error_band_m2.description: From the walls' and footprints' error bands along their edges.

kept_ids.description: Objects and built-ins whose footprints were taken out.

HeroMask.description: Where a thing is in one hero photo, for taking it out of that photo.

mask.description: PNG, white where the thing is, at the keyframe's resolution. Not dilated.

visible_share.description: Share of the thing's box that is in frame and not hidden behind something nearer.

source.description: detected: the detector's own mask in this keyframe. prompted: segmented from the thing's box projected into the photo.

outline.description: The mask's outer edges as closed polygons on the photo, largest first, simplified to within about 0.3% of the photo's width. The app draws the outline when the thing is tapped, without fetching the mask.

HeroView.description: A view the twin is shown from: the pose of a real keyframe, chosen by code for how much of the room it shows, its sharpness and its framing. Never a pose a model made up.

keyframe_id.description: The keyframe whose pose, intrinsics and photo this view uses.

coverage.description: Share of the scanned room this view shows.

sharpness.description: Variance of the Laplacian of the keyframe; higher is sharper.

ImagePoint.description: A point on a photo as a share of its width (x, from the left) and height (y, from the top).

Inventory.description: The open-vocabulary inventory the objects were found from, and what could not be placed.

InventoryItem.description: An item a vision model listed that could not be placed in 3D. Kept and shown, never dropped silently.

tried.description: Detector prompts and models tried to place it.

captured_at_ms.description: Milliseconds from the start of the capture.

world.description: Where the detection hit the AR scene, when it did.

LocalId.description: Identifier that is unique inside its parent object, for example a wall or a design item.

Material.description: Wall paint or flooring, a first-class part of the design.

MeasurementConfidence.description: How a room's lengths were measured. taped: a tape value the person entered checked or set them. ar_measured: the phone's AR (planes or LiDAR) measured them. estimated: a depth model guessed them from pictures, as for imported photos and videos; the app shows sizes with measure to confirm and makes no fit claim.

basis.description: Where the room's lengths came from.

tape_values.description: Tape values the person entered for this room.

Money.description: A price. Set only from retailer data, never by a generative model.

MoveEdit.title: MoveEdit
MoveEdit.description: Move an object: its box centre moves, its measured size does not.

by.description: Who made the edit. Never a model.

ObjectModel.description: A 3D model made from the object's own crops. Scaled to the measured box; the model never sets the size.

generator.description: Model name and pinned version that made it.

ObjectType.description: The type of an item in the room.

offset.description: Distance along the wall from its start to the near edge of the opening.

swing.description: Door swing. Its clearance is a hard rule.

OrientedBox.description: An object's measured box: centre, turn about the vertical axis and size. Sizes are dimensions with a source and an error band.

PhoneSplat.description: A decimated, compressed room splat for on-device viewing.

tier.description: capable: recent phones (500k Gaussians). budget: budget Android (250k).

Plan.title: Plan
Plan.description: Spatial view: the dimensioned 2D plan derived from one design and its space profile.

verified.description: False draws the error band as a soft halo.

ok.description: True only when the distance minus its error band meets the minimum.

Point2.description: A point on the floor in the space frame, in metres.

Point3.description: A point in the space frame, in metres. z is height above the floor.

Polygon.description: Closed floor polygon; the last point joins the first.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: A real, curated catalog item. Dimensions, price and stock come from retailer data and checks, never from a generative model.

source.description: Catalog source key, as recorded in the catalog sources tracker.

category.description: Fine category, for example sofa or floor_lamp.

dimensions.title: ProductDimensions
dimensions.description: Only measured dimensions may sit in tight spots.

checked_at.description: When price, stock and link were last checked.

image_use_permitted.description: A product enters the contract only with permission to use its images.

routes.description: At least one permitted buy or rent route.

ProductGroup.description: Top-level grouping used for the cost breakdown.

ProductRoute.description: A permitted affiliate or rental route to a product.

url.description: Retailer destination. The app always opens it through the redirect service.

price.description: Purchase price for buy routes; price per month for rent routes.

ProductSize.description: A catalog product's size: retailer data, so measured or estimated, never set by a model.

Redesign.description: Whether a redesign keeps this thing or may replace it. The rule keeps fixtures (fans, lights, AC units, switchboards, geysers) and lets everything else be replaced; the person can change it.

RedoArea.description: What the user wants redone: all of the scanned space, or just a part they drew around.

polygon.description: The part to redo, in the space frame. Present when scope is part; the design engine checks this.

RemoveEdit.title: RemoveEdit
RemoveEdit.description: Remove an object; the fill behind it is a render concern.

by.description: Who made the edit. Never a model.

Render.title: Render
Render.description: Visualisation stage: an image derived from one design. Always labelled illustrative.

kind.description: guided_photo is a guided edit of the user's own photo; fallback_3d is the clean 3D render shown when checks fail.

source_media_id.description: The capture media this render is seen from.

illustrative.description: Every render carries the illustrative label.

model.title: ModelRef
model.description: Pinned model that produced a guided photo render.

checks.title: RenderChecks
checks.description: Required for guided_photo renders, enforced by the render step: a guided photo reaches a user only when all four pass.

ReplaceEdit.title: ReplaceEdit
ReplaceEdit.description: Replace an object with a catalog product of the given size.

by.description: Who made the edit. Never a model.
Who made the edit. Never a model.

RotateEdit.title: RotateEdit
RotateEdit.description: Turn an object about the vertical axis.

by.description: Who made the edit. Never a model.

SafeRegion.title: SafeRegion
SafeRegion.description: Where the camera may stand: within radius_m of any anchor. Anchors are the keyframe camera positions along the capture path, in the space frame. A viewing limit, not a room measurement.

ScaleEvidence.description: Independent scale anchors and whether they agree.

implied_scale.description: Scale factor this anchor implies for the reconstruction.

anchors_agree.description: Agreement tightens error bands; disagreement widens them.

needs_tape_value.description: True when the app should ask for one tape value.

SchemaVersion.description: Contract version of the object. Minor versions only add optional fields.

Shell.description: The room itself: floor, walls, ceiling, doors, windows and wall fixtures.

surfaces.description: Appearance of each wall, the floor and the ceiling.

built_ins.description: Built-in items, kept with the shell.

id.description: A wall's id, or floor or ceiling.

texture.description: Photo texture projected from the keyframes with objects masked out.

ShoppingList.title: ShoppingList
ShoppingList.description: Commerce stage: the buyable view of one design. Totals come from the same items the render shows.

checked_at.description: When budget and stock were last re-checked.

north_deg.description: Compass bearing of the space frame's positive y axis.

confidence.description: confirmed only when more than the compass agrees. Strict Vastu needs confirmed.

SpaceProfile.title: SpaceProfile
SpaceProfile.description: Understanding stage: the scanned space as a scene graph. It may be a whole room or only part of one. Geometry models estimate, tape verifies; every dimension carries a value, a source and an error band.

extent.description: How much was scanned: a whole room, or part of one such as a corner or one wall.

verification.description: verified only when tape values cover the space's key dimensions.

floor_polygon.description: The scanned floor area. For a partial scan this is only the part that was covered.

walls.description: Walls seen in the scan. A partial scan may have one or two.

SpaceTwin.title: SpaceTwin
SpaceTwin.description: The 3D digital twin of a scanned space: the room shell and every object as its own editable item. Built from one immutable capture; a new reconstruction is a new version, and edits are deltas kept outside the twin. Every dimension carries a value, a source and an error band; generated 3D models never set an object's size, the measured box does. The space frame is metric: x and y on the floor (as in SpaceProfile), z up from the floor.

capture_id.description: The capture this twin was built from. The capture never changes.

version.description: Reconstruction version for this capture. Designs reference a twin id and version.

objects.description: Every object found in the space, each its own item.

keyframes.description: Sharp frames with camera poses and intrinsics, in the space frame.

phone_splats.description: Compressed room splats for viewing on the phone, one per device tier. Colour only; built from the room splat.

confidence.description: How far the room's measurements can be trusted. Fit claims only at taped or ar_measured.

areas.description: The spaces the capture passed through, split where the floor narrows to a doorway. One area when the capture is one space (an open-plan L included). The app shows each area's photo and asks which to redesign.

SpaceType.description: What the scanned space is. Detected from the scan, never picked up front; the user can change it.

SplatRef.description: The photoreal room splat trained on the keyframes.

StorageKey.description: Object key in the media store. Never a public URL; clients receive signed URLs.

tile_size.description: Side of one tile, when the material is tile.

product_id.description: Catalog product for a restyle (paint or flooring).

TapeMeasurement.description: An optional value read from a tape by the user.

age_band.description: A weak prior for the first guess only. Never filters products and is never shown back as a label.

TasteProfile.title: TasteProfile
TasteProfile.description: Personalisation stage: a learned taste, as a vector plus readable attributes the user can view, correct and reset.

style_blend.description: The taste described as a blend of the launch style profiles.

summary.description: The taste in plain words, editable by the user. Never mentions the age band.

TwinEdit.description: One change to a twin, kept outside it. Made by the user or the solver, never by a model. Undo is dropping the edit.

category.description: Machine class, for example sofa or almirah.

label.description: Name shown to the user, for example Grey three-seater sofa.

views.description: Masks and best crops from the keyframes that see this object.

splat_subset.description: This object's part of the room splat.

state.description: keep in a freshly built twin. Edits change it only in a derived view, never in the stored twin.

object_type.description: What kind of thing it is. Built-ins are not objects: they are in the shell's built_ins.

hero_masks.description: One per hero view this thing is visible in.

TwinReference.description: Which twin a design builds on, and the ordered edits it makes to it.

Viewing.description: Where the twin may be shown from. The room splat only holds up near where the phone stood, so the viewer and the reveal use only the hero views, their orbits, and camera positions inside the safe region.

hero_views.description: Six to ten views when the capture allows, best first.

ViewOrbit.title: ViewOrbit
ViewOrbit.description: How far the camera may move and turn around a hero view. Viewing limits, not room measurements.

max_offset_m.description: Largest distance of the camera from the hero pose, in metres.

max_yaw_deg.description: Largest turn about the vertical axis, either way.

kind.description: What this edge of the floor polygon is. wall (the default when absent): a wall was seen here, from near the floor to near the ceiling. open: no wall was seen between the walls on either side: a doorway, the way into the next area, or a stretch that was not scanned. Open edges are passable, never a surface to place things against.
